name: Box Turn (backward half)
notes: Owner's description: follows Box Turn (forward half); a backward step on the opposite (left) foot with the same quarter turn clockwise, counts 1-2-3, feet closing on 3. Step sizes and rise are assumptions the owner accepted for now (2026-11-16), the same as the forward half mirrored backwards: 0.5 back, then the right foot lands 0.4 beyond the left in the turned frame; no rise. The whole quarter turn is placed on step 2. Measured from the facing before the turn, step 2 is 0.9 back and 0.2 left. The lead goes back on step 2, so the couple turns round him (the default turning centre) and he takes the step as written while the follow travels round him. Exempt from the "partner spacing" check (2026-11-17): with the offset hold she sits to his right, so on count 2 her right foot swings round past his standing right foot, 7.6 cm from it, centre to centre. In technique this is the outside partner having to get past on a natural turn; how her step should go (a heel turn for him, the turn split between counts) is left for the figure clean-up. Remove skipChecks once it's fixed. Turn timing from the book (2026-11-17, a box-step study card: the partner going forward turns 1/8 between 1 and 2 and 1/8 between 2 and 3; the partner going back turns 1/4 between 1 and 2, "body turns less", and the body completes the turn on 3): the bodies turn 1/8 right on count 2 and 1/8 on the close, and the lead, going back on the inside of the turn, points the foot a further 1/8 on count 2 (`pointing`), so his feet make the whole quarter between 1 and 2. The close's turn is carried back into count 2's foot placement, so the feet land exactly where they did with the whole quarter on count 2.
